estimators.ratio: mean(Masstree rounds) / mean(Expanse rounds) — or Expanse / Masstree for throughput — with a two-sample BCa 95% interval (scripts/bca_bootstrap.py); each of `base` and `head` is that reduction over its own rounds, the two builds having alternated round by round inside the cell (scripts/bench_ab.py)
estimators.columns: per-arm columns are medians of the same rounds; the ratio column is not the quotient of the two median columns beside it
estimators.raw: every cell carries rounds_raw, the per-round samples verbatim

ab.harness: one harness, two engines: the head tree's harness sources built against each tree's engine, so only the engine differs between the two builds
ab.order: base first on even rounds, head first on odd rounds; each process runs one round at its offset so the harness's competitor-first alternation is continuous
